issues.title: User Story: View photo message from babysitter
issues.description:
Acceptance Criteria: 

* Parents should be able to get an alert when a child seems off within an image/video
* Parents should be to save images in an album for later on to look at as well as share them to their photos on their device
* Parents should be able to know when the video/image was sent and from which device
* Parents should be able to respond back to babysitters after an image/video is sent
* Parents should be notified that their photo was saved successfully

issues.title: User Story: View Childcare Information
issues.description:
Acceptance Criteria:

* The screen displays important care information, including food and allergies, preferences, where things are,  instructions, emergency contacts 
* Information is organized in sections divided by each category as well as in steps for “if something goes wrong” section (includes information about which hospital to go to/who to contact)
* User Action 1: User taps a care item
* Expected System Behavior: The system displays additional details or instructions for that item
* Error condition: Information for a category has not been provided
* Error message: “No information provided”

issues.title: User Story: View Childcare Schedule
issues.description:
Acceptance Criteria:

* The screen displays the child’s daily schedule with information about their events and requests made by the parents (daily tasks)
* Information is organized and easy to scan
* User Action 1: User taps a scheduled activity to confirm they have completed an item which navigates them to the picture proof
* Expected System Behavior: The system shows relevant information about the activity
* Error condition: Information for an activity is not provided
* Error message: “No information provided”

issues.title: User Story: Send photo message to parent
issues.description:
Acceptance Criteria: 

* Babysitters are required to send a picture confirmation of a completed tasks with an option to include additional notes. After this is done, the check appears filled in.
* Babysitters should be able to access a general messaging portal to be able to ask follow up questions for constant communication
* The system should distinguish normal messages vs messages for a completed tasks  
* Babysitters should not have the option to add photos after the babysitting session is completed

User Story: Logging Care Details
issues.description:
Acceptance Criteria:

* The screen displays completed daily tasks with notes filled out with details about feedings or care.
* Information is organized chronologically and easy to scan
* User Action 1: User taps on the Log menu to attach details to a specific task they have completed.
  * Expected System Behavior: The system pulls up relevant details about completed tasks for that babysitting session.
* User Action 2: User enters information about task based on category and provided input fields.
  * Expected System Behavior: The system attaches notes to the specified completed task in a chronological view. Any edits or changes will be logged underneath that task and not affect the original time/details of the completed task.
* Error condition: Information for an activity is not provided
* Error message: “No information provided”

issues.title: User Story: View What's Important Today
issues.description:
## **Acceptance Criteria:**

* A clearly labeled **“Today’s Notes”** or **“Important Today”** section is available for the current care session.
* The section displays session-specific information provided by the parent, such as:
  * Changes to the normal routine
  * Special instructions
  * Schedule changes
  * Food or medication reminders
  * Other important notes for that day
* Session-specific information is visually separate from the child’s permanent profile information.
* Information is organized so it can be quickly scanned.
* **User Action 1:** Babysitter opens the current care session.
  * **Expected System Behavior:** The system displays the “Important Today” section near the top of the session view with any notes provided by the parent.
* **User Action 2:** Babysitter selects a note or item that contains additional details.
  * **Expected System Behavior:** The system displays the full note or related instructions without requiring the babysitter to leave the current session.
* **Error Condition:** The parent has not added any session-specific information.
  * **Expected behavior/message:** Display a clear empty state: **“No special updates for today.”**
* **Edge Case:** A note has been updated by the parent after the babysitter has already viewed the session.
  * **Expected behavior:** The latest version of the note is displayed and is visually marked as updated, if feasible for the MVP.

User Story: View Moments Gallery
issues.description:
## **Acceptance Criteria:**

* An accessible gallery button where users can go to view and add photos from their session.
* The section displays images of the child that were previously uploaded or can actively access the camera to take a picture during a happy moment such as:
  * Children smiling
  * Children playing
  * Children learning something new
* Photos in the gallery include all photos that were taken that session, including from completed tasks.
* Photos will be categorized by their source:
  * Task Updates
  * Photo Messages
  * General Moments
* **User Action 1:** Babysitter taps on the gallery button.
  * **Expected System Behavior:** The system displays all photos that were taken from that session  , with the most recent photos at the bottom.
* **User Action 2:** Babysitter selects the plus button.
  * **Expected System Behavior:** The system will prompt the babysitter to upload or take a photo.
* **Error Condition:** No photos have been taken or uploaded.
  * **Expected behavior/message:** Display a clear empty state: **“No photos yet. Continue capturing moments with your child!”**

issues.description:
## Acceptance Criteria:

* The navigation bar follows the [Figma design](<https://www.figma.com/design/13VwwDCOFlBRYSxHJCCgmh/SI-526---Product-Foundation?node-id=196-482&t=RHSmvYGZmjZbH60r-4>) and includes:

* **User Action 1:** User taps a navigation item.
  * **Expected System Behavior:** The app opens the corresponding main page.
* **User Action 2:** User navigates to a different main page.
  * **Expected System Behavior:** The selected navigation item updates to its active state.
* The navigation bar stays consistent across all main pages.
* Icons, labels, spacing, and selected states match the provided Figma design.
* **Error Condition:** A navigation destination cannot be loaded.
  * **Expected behavior/message:** The app should remain stable and should not send the user to an incorrect page.

issues.title: User Story: View Current Session Schedule [Babysitter]
issues.description:
## Acceptance Criteria:

* The Schedule page shows the current care
* Scheduled activities are shown in chronological order.
* Each activity shows its time, activity name, and notes.
* **User Action 1:** Caregiver opens the Schedule page.
  * **Expected System Behavior:** The system displays the schedule for the current care session in chronological order.
* **User Action 2:** Caregiver switches to another date using the date controls.
  * **Expected System Behavior:** The system displays the schedule associated with the selected date.
* **User Action 3:** Caregiver switches between List and Calendar view.
  * **Expected System Behavior:** The system displays the same scheduled care sessions in the selected format.
* **Error Condition:** No schedule has been added for the current care session.
  * **Expected behavior/message:** Display **“No schedule has been added for this shift.”** and give the caregiver the option to **Request Schedule** from the parent.

## Designs:

issues.title: User Story: Add & Edit Schedule [Parent]
issues.description:
## Acceptance Criteria:

* Parent's Schedule page shows upcoming care sessions with the date, time, children, and assigned caregiver.
* Parents can switch between **List** and **Calendar** views.
* Parents can edit or create a new schedule from the Schedule page.
* **User Action 1:** Parent switches between List and Calendar view.
  * **Expected System Behavior:** The system displays the same scheduled care sessions in the selected format.
* **User Action 2:** Parent selects **Add Schedule**.
  * **Expected System Behavior:** The system opens the Schedule Details page where the parent can enter the date, start and end time, children, caregiver, scheduled activities, and notes.
* **User Action 3:** Parent saves a new schedule.
  * **Expected System Behavior:** The new schedule is added and appears on both the List and Calendar views.
* **Error Condition:** Required information such as the date, time, or child is missing.
  * **Expected behavior/message:** The system identifies the missing field and asks the parent to complete it before saving.

* Expected System Behavior: The system displays additional details or instructions for that child
* Error condition: Information for a category has not been provided
* Error message: “No information provided”

User Story: View profile page
issues.description:
**Acceptance Criteria:**

* The Profile page displays the user's personal information, such as name, profile picture, and contact details.
* Account settings, including login, logout, and profile management, are accessible within the same Profile page.
* Users can view and edit their personal information.
* **User Action 1:** User taps the “Profile” tab in the navigation bar.
* **Expected System Behavior:** The system displays the Profile page with personal information and account management options.
* **Error condition:** Profile information is missing or has not been provided.
* **Error message:** “No information provided.”

issues.description:
## Acceptance Criteria

* Babysitters can view and add entries for the current care session.
* Care Log entries are associated with the correct child and session.
* The Messages experience is removed.
* Care Log content is no longer duplicated on the Home page.

## Prototype

issues.title: Allow babysitters to add care log entries
issues.description:
**Acceptance Criteria:**

* Babysitter can start a new Care Log entry.
* Babysitter can select the relevant child when needed.
* Babysitter can enter the information required by the approved design.
* Saving adds the new entry to the Care Log.
* The entry remains visible after refreshing or reopening the session.
* If saving fails, the user receives a clear error message and can try again.

issues.title: Build the Current Session Log subpage
issues.description:
**Acceptance Criteria:**

* The page follows the approved Figma design.
* Entries display in chronological order.
* Each entry shows the relevant child, content, and time.
* The page displays the appropriate empty state when no entries exist.
* Works for sessions involving multiple children.

issues.title: Remove Messages feature from Care Log page
issues.description:
**Acceptance Criteria:**

* Messages UI is removed from the product.
* Removing Messages does not break Care Log or other navigation.
* No dead links to the removed Messages experience remain.

issues.title: Remove Care Log preview from Home
issues.description:
**Acceptance Criteria:**

* Care Log section is removed from Home.
* Care Log remains accessible through the main navigation.
* Removing the section does not remove or modify existing Care Log data.

issues.title: Keep Current Household Pinned on Children Page
issues.description:
## Acceptance Criteria:

* Keep the currently selected household section visible at the top of the babysitter’s Children page.
* Switching households updates the pinned household information.
* Child information shown below always corresponds to the selected household.

## Prototype:

issues.title: Refine Home Page Content
issues.description:
## Acceptance Criteria

* Home shows only the most relevant upcoming schedule activity.
* Checklist is available from Home.
* Only the Primary Contact is shown.
* Misleading or redundant navigation is removed.
* Updated Home sections follow the approved Figma design.

issues.title: Show Only the Next Upcoming Activity
issues.description:
**Acceptance Criteria:**

* Home shows only the next upcoming scheduled activity.
* Preview includes the activity name and scheduled time.
* Section uses the approved heading, such as **“What’s next”** or **“Upcoming activity”**
* After an activity has passed, the next scheduled activity is shown.
* If there are no remaining activities, display the empty state.
* Full schedule remains available from the Schedule page.

issues.title: Add Checklist to Home and Schedule
issues.description:
**Acceptance Criteria:**

* Checklist appears on both Home and Schedule.
* Both pages display the same checklist items.
* Checking or unchecking an item in one location updates it in the other.
* Checklist state persists when navigating between pages.
* Appropriate empty state appears if no checklist items have been added.

issues.title: Show Only One Primary Contact on Home
issues.description:
**Acceptance Criteria:**

* Home displays only one designated Primary Contact.
* Primary Contact name is shown.
* Approved contact action or information is available.
* Other contacts remain accessible through the relevant child or household information page.
* If no Primary Contact exists, display empty state.

issues.title: Remove “View All” from Good to Know
issues.description:
**Acceptance Criteria:**

* **View All** button is removed from Good to Know.
* Existing Good to Know cards remain visible and functional.
* Removing the button does not change the content shown in Good to Know.

issues.title: Improve Parent Schedule Details Editing
issues.description:
## Acceptance Criteria

* Schedule Details supports sessions involving multiple children.
* Activity time entry is quick and consistent.
* Added activities save and display correctly.
* Parents can remove individual activities.
* Parents can delete the entire care session.

## Prototype:

issues.title: Support Multiple Children in Schedule Details
issues.description:
**Acceptance Criteria:**

* Schedule Details shows all children assigned to the care session.
* Parent can assign an activity to the appropriate child or children.
* Multiple children can be selected where supported by the design.
* Child selections remain after saving.
* Reopening Schedule Details shows the previously selected children.

issues.title: Improve Time Picker
issues.description:
**Acceptance Criteria:**

* New activities default to the care session’s start time.
* Time is selected using a wheel picker in 5-minute intervals.
* Parents can adjust the activity time before saving.
* The selected time is preserved after the activity is saved.
* The picker only allows valid times within the supported schedule format.

issues.title: Fix Activities Not Saving or Displaying While Editing
issues.description:
**Acceptance Criteria:**

* Newly added activity appears immediately in the Schedule Details activity list.
* Previously added activities remain visible while more activities are added.
* Activity name, time, child selection, and details are preserved.
* All activities remain after saving the schedule.
* Reopening the schedule displays all previously saved activities.
* No entered activity disappears without a user action.

issues.title: Add Delete Action for Individual Activities
issues.description:
**Acceptance Criteria:**

* Each activity includes a Delete action based on the approved design.
* Parent can delete an individual activity.
* Deleting one activity does not affect other activities.
* Deleted activity no longer appears in the schedule.
* Updated schedule persists after saving and reopening.

issues.title: Add Delete Schedule Action
issues.description:
**Acceptance Criteria:**

* Schedule Details includes a Delete Schedule action.
* User is asked to confirm before the schedule is permanently deleted.
* Confirming removes the entire care session and its associated schedule.
* Deleted session no longer appears in List or Calendar views.
* Canceling the confirmation leaves the schedule unchanged.

User Story: Fix Care Log Flow
issues.description:
**Acceptance Criteria:**

* User Action 1: User taps “Add entry.”
* Expected System Behavior: The system opens the new entry form without redirecting to Home.
* User Action 2: User writes an update, attaches a photo, or adds both.
* Expected System Behavior: The system displays the text and a preview of any attached photos, allowing the user to remove photos before saving.
* User Action 3: User taps “Save.”
* Expected System Behavior: The system saves the entry, including attached photos, and displays it in the current session’s Care Log.
* Error condition: A photo cannot be uploaded.
* Error message: “Your photo couldn’t be uploaded. Please try again.”
* Error condition: The entry cannot be saved.
* Error message: “Your entry couldn’t be saved. Please try again.”
* The system preserves the draft text and successfully attached photos so the user can retry.

User Story: Share Photo Memories to Help Parents Feel Connected
issues.description:
**Acceptance Criteria:**

* The photo upload area is labeled “Share a moment.”
* Supporting text explains its purpose: “Help parents feel part of their child’s day by sharing moments and memories.”
* Photo sharing is clearly marked as optional.
* User Action 1: User taps “Share a moment.”
* Expected System Behavior: The system allows the user to select a photo and add an optional caption.
* User Action 2: User previews the photo and taps “Share.”
* Expected System Behavior: The photo and caption appear in the current session’s Care Log for the parent to view.
* Error condition: The photo cannot be uploaded.
* Error message: “Your photo couldn’t be shared. Please try again.”
* The system preserves the selected photo and caption so the user can retry.
